2. At least 800m from Hudson River OR East River

The condition "距离 Hudson River 或 East River 至少 800 米" means distance to Hudson River **or** East River is at least 800m. This means the building is at least 800m away from both rivers (at least 800m from Hudson AND at least 800m from East River), i.e., the *minimum* distance to the union of rivers is >= 800m. So "at least 800m from [Hudson OR East River]" means at least 800m from either one — i.e., distance to the nearest river bank >= 800m.

6. Buildings that are at least 800m from a river = buildings NOT within the 800m river buffer → candidate B.
